scope: Admission-bound native fee checking in the complete fixed loan/swap comparator and its local/Preview production callers; source-only. No operational admission or SP05 completion.

findings.detail: Every comparator requires a finite uint128 bigint native SPECK cap. The accepted-stage counter uses exact bigint arithmetic and checks nativeFee <= cap - spent. Native receipt debit must still equal the decoded native transaction fee; unresolved indexer values cannot provide the ceiling. Any failed comparison stops the trace.

Historical stage groups are a unique contiguous prefix with separately copied caps and separate counters. Neither old/current nor two different historical groups can transfer unused allowance. Counters update only after all financial validation succeeds. The remaining complete state/effect/UTXO/role/network/replay comparisons remain in force.

Historical ceilings come from exact hash-bound original ADMITTED records and matching proposal hashes, each originally authorizing 2000000000000000 SPECK. Fixed local mappings correctly associate execution04 deployment, recovery03 initialize, continuation02 accrue/settle and swap01 deploy/initialize. Existing canonical public history gates bind fixed transaction bytes and identities; caller adapters remain source-test-only. This selected-trace check does not replace the reservation ledger or release any prior charge.

Preview receives only its current limits.dustFee ceiling; local fresh/recovery/continuation/stale paths pass their current ceiling plus only fixed historical groups. All direct production comparator callsites were inspected. Closed driver/integration diagnostics preserve NATIVE_FEE_CAP_EXCEEDED; the connected Preview test rejects at the fourth stage and retains both codes while cleanup runs.

Independent execution re-decodes all four exact retained Preview loan public native payloads and compares their full supplied financial trace under the original plan cap: 1200000000000004 <= 2000000000000000 SPECK. Synthetic capability commitments are explicitly substituted; no original secrets, new finality, proof verification, or renewed ledger acceptance are established. Original financial results and FAILED/INCOMPLETE wrappers remain hash-identical.

No full SP05, mandatory PCD settlement, release, or new Preview acceptance is claimed. A separate independent review and any later resource admission remain required.
